description: Creates a project at the end of a projects showcase: title, subtitle (e.g. type and location), description, detail values by key, and categories. Use it for each job in a portfolio, then upload its photos with upload_photos and project. Only call after showing the plan to the user and getting explicit confirmation. A project with the same title (or slug) is returned instead of a duplicate, and retries are safe; category names that don't exist yet are created.

categories.description: Category names, slugs, or ids (the showcase's filter tabs); missing names are created, e.g. ["Custom Homes"].

description.description: Plain text shown on the project page (cards show its start), e.g. "A two-story custom home with an arched entry."; null clears it.

details.description: Detail values by key (see get_project_details): numbers as numbers (the unit is separate), select as an option value, dates as YYYY-MM-DD, links as URLs; null clears one, e.g. { "square_footage": 3200, "year": 2024 }.

showcaseId.description: Projects showcase id from list_showcases or create_showcase, e.g. "0190f5c2-7b1e-7c3a-9d2f-1a2b3c4d5e6f".

slug.description: URL form used in project page links, e.g. "arched-entry-two-story"; derived from the title when omitted.

subtitle.description: The line under the title, often type and location, e.g. "Custom Home · Zebulon, NC"; null clears it.

name: create_project
title: Create project
